zh.title: 星宇航空9月營收年增69% 客貨運收入同步成長
zh.summary: 星宇航空9月營收年增69%，客運、貨運收入也都較去年成長。
body: 星宇航空表示，9月營收為新臺幣49.75億元，年增69%。其中，客運營收37.2億元，年增70%；貨運營收7.06億元，年增59%，月增5%。
航線佈局方面，星宇航空表示，10月起陸續開闢臺北至峇裏島、臺中至札幌及臺中至名古屋航線。公司指出，目前從臺中出發營運10個航點，每週航班達62班。
星宇航空表示，與美國航空（American Airlines）於9月30日展開聯營合作。旅客自臺北飛抵美國後，可透過共掛航班銜接美國航空航網。

en.title: Starlux Airlines reports 69% year-on-year revenue growth in September
en.summary: Starlux Airlines reported September revenue growth, with passenger and cargo revenue also up year on year.
body: Starlux Airlines said its September revenue was NT$49.75 hundred million, up 69% year on year. Passenger revenue reached NT$3.72 billion, a 70% increase, while cargo revenue was NT$706 million, up 59% year on year and 5% month on month.
The airline said it would open Taipei-Bali, Taichung-Sapporo and Taichung-Nagoya routes from October. It also said it currently operates 10 destinations from Taichung, with 62 weekly flights.

Starlux said its new joint cooperation with American Airlines began on September 30. Passengers flying from Taipei to the United States can connect to American Airlines’ network through codeshare flights.

zh.title: 漢莎航空波音747-8於洛杉磯機場（LAX）放棄降落 驚險避開擦尾
zh.summary: 漢莎航空波音747-8在洛杉磯機場放棄降落；最終延誤近半小時落地
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，漢莎航空一架波音747-8在洛杉磯國際機場（LAX）放棄降落，過程中險些發生擦尾。報導以「差之毫釐」形容這次驚險情況。
Simple Flying 的報導標題指出，該架四引擎客機的機組人員在最後階段放棄降落，飛機逃過一次擦尾事件。
報導摘要說明，這架四引擎客機最終落地時間較表定晚了將近半小時。
目前取得的資料僅包含 Simple Flying 的標題與摘要，未提供事件確切日期、航班編號、註冊號碼或後續調查資訊，因此無法進一步確認細節。

en.title: Lufthansa Boeing 747-8 aborts landing at LAX, narrowly avoiding tail strike
en.summary: Lufthansa Boeing 747-8 aborts landing at LAX; narrowly avoids tail strike, touches down about half an hour late
body: A Lufthansa Boeing 747-8 aborted its landing at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) and narrowly avoided a tail strike, according to Simple Flying.
The Simple Flying headline states that the pilots aborted the landing and that the aircraft escaped a tail strike by inches.
The report's summary says the quadjet eventually touched down just under half an hour behind schedule.

The available material consists only of the Simple Flying headline and summary. It does not state the date of the occurrence, a flight number, a registration, or any investigation details, so those points cannot be confirmed.

zh.title: 希斯洛機場（LHR）稱逾40家航空公司尋求時刻 擴建呼聲升高
zh.summary: 希斯洛機場稱逾40家航空公司尋求時刻，擴建呼聲升高。
body: 希斯洛機場（LHR）表示，目前有逾40家航空公司尋求取得起降時刻，擴建及興建第三條跑道的呼聲也在升高。機場管理層稱，時刻需求持續超過可用容量，航空公司因此選擇海外競爭樞紐。
希斯洛機場主張，擴大機場可為新航空公司及航線提供空間，增加競爭並降低消費者票價。機場執行長 Thomas Woldbye 預計於本週稍晚，出席英國國會交通委員會有關希斯洛擴建國家政策聲明的聽證會；該聲明目前正由國會審查。

en.title: Heathrow says more than 40 airlines seek slots as expansion calls grow
en.summary: Heathrow says over 40 airlines seek slots as expansion calls intensify.
body: Heathrow Airport (LHR) says more than 40 airlines are currently seeking access to slots as calls for expansion and a third runway intensify. Airport management said demand for access continues to exceed available capacity, forcing airlines to choose competing hubs overseas.

Heathrow argued that a larger airport would create space for new airlines and routes, increase competition and drive down fares for consumers. CEO Thomas Woldbye is due to give evidence later this week at the Transport Select Committee hearing on the Heathrow Expansion National Policy Statement, which is currently being reviewed by parliament.

zh.title: 空中巴士U740 Valkyrie無人作戰機完成歐洲首飛
zh.summary: 空中巴士與Kratos完成U740 Valkyrie歐洲首次飛行；目標2029年交付可作戰無人協同作戰飛機
body: 空中巴士（Airbus）於2026年10月12日表示，與Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc.（NASDAQ：KTOS）合作，已在歐洲成功完成「U740-Valkyrie」的首次飛行。空中巴士指出，這項里程碑確認雙方有望在2029年前交付可作戰的無人協同作戰飛機（Collaborative Combat Aircraft，CCA），以回應德國及其他歐洲武裝部隊的作戰需求。
空中巴士說明，這次飛行在北歐一處測試設施進行，達成所有目標，包括不依賴跑道的火箭輔助起飛、在多種高度與速度下進行機動，速度達Mach 0.8，以及飛行中任務調整。空中巴士表示，這次首飛為後續搭配MARS任務系統的更複雜飛行測試鋪路。
空中巴士國防與太空執行長Mike Schoellhorn表示，在日益複雜且充滿競爭的威脅環境中，空軍需要可負擔的作戰量能。空中巴士引述其說法指出，結合Kratos成熟機體與空中巴士具主權的歐洲任務系統，可提供強健、具主權、可負擔且可作戰的CCA系統，並稱Valkyrie也將在提升Eurofighter等有人作戰飛機的航程、火力與存活率上扮演關鍵角色。
Kratos總裁兼執行長Eric DeMarco表示，首飛通常會帶來許多學習機會，但由於Valkyrie系統的成熟度以及空中巴士與Kratos團隊的良好整合，這次飛行是極大的成功。空中巴士引述其說法指出，雙方結合優勢可讓可負擔的Valkyrie系統與Kratos的CCA及無人機製造經驗持續演進。
空中巴士指出，U740 Valkyrie長9.1公尺、翼展8.2公尺，具備內部武器艙與機翼下方外部酬載掛點。空中巴士表示，該機最大起飛重量約3公噸、航程超過5,000公里、使用升限45,000英尺。
空中巴士表示，U740 Valkyrie的設計可在自主模式下運作，或接受Eurofighter等有人戰機指揮，執行高風險任務並保護有人資產。

en.title: Airbus U740 Valkyrie uncrewed combat aircraft completes first flight in Europe
en.summary: Airbus and Kratos complete U740 Valkyrie's first flight in Europe; combat-ready CCA targeted by 2029
body: Airbus said on October 12, 2026 that it had successfully completed the first flight of the "U740-Valkyrie" in Europe in partnership with Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. (NASDAQ: KTOS). Airbus said the milestone confirms that the two companies are on track to deliver a combat-ready uncrewed Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) by 2029, addressing the operational requirements of the German and other European Armed Forces.

According to Airbus, the flight was conducted at a test facility in Northern Europe and achieved all objectives, including a runway independent rocket-assisted take-off, manoeuvers at various altitudes and speeds up to Mach 0.8, as well as in-flight mission adjustments. Airbus said the debut paves the way for subsequent, more sophisticated flight tests with its MARS mission system.

Mike Schoellhorn, CEO of Airbus Defence and Space, said that in an increasingly complex and contested threat environment, air forces require affordable combat mass. Airbus quoted him as saying that pairing Kratos' proven airframe with Airbus' sovereign European mission system would offer a robust, sovereign, affordable and combat-ready CCA system by the end of the decade, and that the Valkyrie will also play a critical role in enhancing crewed combat aircraft such as the Eurofighter with extended range, firepower and survivability.

Eric DeMarco, President and CEO of Kratos, said first flights typically include plenty of learning opportunities, but that with the maturity of the Valkyrie system and the well-integrated Airbus and Kratos team, this flight was an amazing success. Airbus quoted him as saying that combining the strengths of Kratos and Airbus enables the affordable Valkyrie system and Kratos' CCA and drone manufacturing legacy to evolve.

Airbus said the U740 Valkyrie has a length of 9.1m and a wingspan of 8.2m, and features an internal weapons bay and external payload stations under the wings. Airbus said it has a maximum take-off weight of approximately three tonnes, a range exceeding 5,000 kilometres and a service ceiling of 45,000 feet.
Airbus said the U740 Valkyrie is engineered to operate autonomously or under the command of crewed fighters, such as the Eurofighter, to execute high-risk missions and protect crewed assets.

zh.title: Avolon訂購250架波音與空中巴士客機，仍待股東批准
zh.summary: Avolon訂購250架波音與空中巴士客機，交易仍待股東批准。
body: Avolon已向波音與空中巴士訂購250架新飛機，但訂單仍須其持股70%的股東Bohai Leasing批准。Avolon於10月9日宣佈這項交易；若獲批准，公司已承諾的飛機總數將增至749架。
訂單包括140架波音737 MAX，以及110架空中巴士飛機，其中75架屬A320neo系列、35架屬A330neo系列。Avolon另取得再選購100架空中巴士飛機的選擇權，供其因應航空公司需求調整機隊。

en.title: Avolon orders 250 Boeing and Airbus aircraft, pending shareholder approval
en.summary: Avolon orders 250 aircraft from Boeing and Airbus, pending shareholder approval.
body: Avolon has placed firm orders for 250 new aircraft from Boeing and Airbus, but the orders remain subject to approval by Bohai Leasing, its 70% shareholder. The company announced the deal on 9 October. Once approved, the orders would take Avolon’s total firm aircraft commitments to 749.

The package comprises 140 Boeing 737 MAX aircraft and 110 Airbus jets, including 75 A320neo family aircraft and 35 A330neo family aircraft. Avolon also secured options for 100 additional Airbus aircraft, giving it flexibility to expand its portfolio as airline requirements evolve.

zh.title: 美軍莫哈維沙漠演習測試無人機 設備限制浮現
zh.summary: 美軍莫哈維沙漠演習測試無人機，伺服器過熱且電池無法充電
body: 美國陸軍在加州莫哈維沙漠舉行為期十天的 Project Convergence-Capstone 6 演習，地點為 Fort Irwin，時間在七月。Aerospace Global News 報導，演習在實際條件下測試新興技術與戰場網路，也測試陸軍的 Next Generation Command and Control（NGC2）架構、無人機、自主系統及電子戰設備；報導稱演習暴露出明顯限制。
報導指出，演習期間伺服器過熱，電池耗盡後無法重新充電。部分士兵只在有限時段操作無人機，飛行時間為最大飛行時間的一半，以節省電池並取回無人機；部分飛行未使用完整自主能力，也沒有 AI 輔助。

en.title: US Army drone trials face equipment limits during Mojave Desert exercise
en.summary: US Army drone trials in California faced overheated servers and batteries that could not be recharged.
body: The US Army held Project Convergence-Capstone 6, a ten-day exercise in July in California’s Mojave Desert at Fort Irwin. Aerospace Global News reports that the exercise tested emerging technologies and battlefield networks under realistic conditions, including the Army’s Next Generation Command and Control (NGC2) architecture, drones, autonomous systems and electronic-warfare equipment. The report says the exercise exposed significant limitations.

Servers overheated during the exercise, and batteries died and could not be recharged, according to the report. Some soldiers flew drones only during limited windows and for half the maximum flight time to conserve batteries and retrieve the drones. The report also says some flights took place without full autonomy or any AI assistance.
